## Implement

1. In `baseOverlaySection` (`internal/engine/baseoverlay.go`), replace `otherChanged bool` with an `otherFiles []string` slice. Fill it from every changed path that is not a non-test `.go` file, in the loop at lines 51-57. Sort and compact it like `goFiles`.
2. Return nil only when both `goFiles` and `otherFiles` are empty; today the nil return at line 60 depends on `goFiles` alone. When `goFiles` is empty, skip the entries loop and the all-files overlay.
3. Cap `otherFiles` at `baseOverlayLimit`, with a separate `otherLeftOut` count. The Go list and its `leftOut` are unchanged.
4. For each listed other file, reject a path that is not a plain relative path (`!filepath.IsLocal(p) || path.IsAbs(p)`), as `writeBaseOverlay` does. Otherwise run `e.gitRead(ctx, rec.Worktree, "show", mergeBase+":"+p)`; the content is discarded.
   - Success gives the line ``- Other file `P`: `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:P` `` (ShellWord on the worktree and on `mergeBase+":"+p`).
   - `notInBase(err)` gives ``- Other file `P`: new in this slice, no base version`` and no command.
   - Any other error, or a rejected path, adds `` `P` `` to the existing `unread` list, so the existing "Check incomplete: the base version of ... could not be read" notice covers it.
   - Start the lines with `- Other file`, not ``- ` ``, so the Go entry count stays the Go files only.
5. Write the section body in this order:
   1. the older-binary note, only when `goFiles` is non-empty;
   2. the Go intro, entries and left-out line, as now;
   3. the other-file lines;
   4. a left-out line for the other files, in the form "N more changed other file(s) was/were left out (ork lists at most 20 of them). Trace the rest yourself with `git show`.";
   5. the `unread` notice;
   6. the existing "overlays cover non-test Go files only" paragraph, kept as is, when `otherFiles` is non-empty.
6. Update the doc comment of `baseOverlaySection`, which says "It returns nil when no Go file changed" and "for changed non-test Go files".
7. In `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`, change, replace and add the tests listed under Failing tests.
